info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Status Query API enables users to retrieve the status of pets available for adoption. Through this endpoint, organizations and individuals can access essential information regarding the current status of pets, allowing them to make informed decisions about pet adoption. This functionality is particularly relevant for shelters, adoption agencies, and potential pet adopters who are interested in tracking the availability of pets. With this API, users can efficiently monitor and manage pet adoption statuses seamlessly.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of available pets.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of all pets in the system. The statuses can indicate whether pets are available for adoption, reserved, or not available. Use this information to manage pet availability effectively.
